description: Save a fact to the project's persistent memory (decisions, patterns, bugs, knowledge). Persists between sessions. Tags: 'private' excludes from context injection; 'superseded' marks as obsolete.

category.description: Category of the fact. 'warning' = negative memory ('NO hacer esto, rompe X') — recalled with a boost so past mistakes surface first.

importance.description: Explicit importance level — critical/high entries surface first in recall, low last. Omit for auto (recency + frequency).

links.description: Related entry keys, separated by space or ';' (e.g. risk-spec engine-arch). Builds graph edges.

path_scope.description: Glob pattern to scope this entry (e.g. src/**.ts). Empty = global.

ttl.description: Time to live (e.g. 7d, 2026-07-17). Empty = no expiration

name: memory_remember
title: Save to Memory
